Jobshout SEO Analyst AI Agent — point it at any URL, get a scored SEO report, then approve fixes before anything ships. Deep dive: long article · Product: jobshout.co.uk.

Watch on YouTube

Bottom line. SEO audits stall when they stay in spreadsheets. Jobshout’s SEO Analyst crawls a live page for title, meta, headings, robots and sitemap health — then Improve mode proposes slug/meta/sitemap fixes and Publish applies them via WordPress, OpsAPI, or a git PR when a repo is set — always with human approval.

We ran a real analyse-only pass against https://www.workstation.co.uk/ with focus keywords devops, kubernetes, hiring. The agent returned an SEO score of 44/100 and concrete fix prompts — not vague advice.

What the report found on tenthmatrix.com

  • High — Missing H1. Pages should have exactly one H1. Fix: add a single H1 matching the primary topic.
  • Medium — Title may be truncated in SERPs (94 characters). Fix: shorten to ≤60 characters.
  • Medium — Meta description length suboptimal (215 characters). Fix: aim for 120–155 characters.

Canonical was missing on the crawl snapshot; sitemap resolved to https://workstation.ai/sitemap.xml. The agent also proposed a slug derived from the title for improve/publish paths.

Why this agent matters

Jobshout is built for specialist agents that do the job in the open and stop for your approval before anything irreversible. SEO Analyst fits that model: analyse freely, propose fixes, publish only when you say yes — WordPress, OpsAPI, or a pull request.
